rules: Numeric fields only. Renderer merges neutral defaults.
All rotation values degrees. Positive wing values open outward, renderer mirrors each side. Negative folds inward. Forewing range -18..22; hindwing -14..25. Four distinct panel hinges stay attached.
Hand coordinates in SVG units; shoulders near (270,456) and (368,447); clamp reach to 48px. Head comes down to mitten for thinking, never grow arms. Keep fingers round.
bodyY is whole-character vertical translation (negative hop), no scale. headY local offset. Foot rotations pivot near heels and retain attachment, range +/-12deg.
eyeL/eyeR openness 0..1.15, eyeJoy -1..1 controls closed arc curvature. gazeX/Y roughly +/-5. Brow rotations +/-18deg, Y +/-9px. mouthSmile -1..1, mouthOpen and mouthO 0..1; continuous path morphs.
antennaL/R signed bend degrees +/-20, deform tip and shaft together; no stump or floating tips.
Props opacity 0..1, same shapes both themes, bulb/heart/breath outside silhouette, tear on cheek.
Day/night geometry identical. No idle RAF. SVG fully vector and independently articulated, not PNG swapping.
